title:
Implements {@link UiSdlRenderCondition} for permission-based component rendering.

If specified in {@link UiSdlConditionalRenderer#condition}, it will render the `thenComponent` when the logged-in
user is a Gen AI Admin or Gen AI Document Admin, and either there is no active project, or the active project is read-only.
Otherwise, the `elseComponent` will be rendered.
name: GenAiUiConditionalRendererIsAtLeastDocAdminAndProjectEditable
